title: QC Gate Results
description: Per-variable results for the three release gates (value range, WCRP compliance, repack) for one (model, experiment, member) combination. Records outcomes only; which checks are required lives in the companion access-moppy-qc-registry.

checked_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp for the whole record

checked_by.description: Tool or GitHub handle that produced this record

source_report.description: Batch report these results were extracted from

variables.description: Keyed by CMIP7 branded variable name; the compound request name or short name are also accepted.

result.description: pass/warn/fail are measured outcomes; implied means the gate is satisfied by inference rather than by a recorded check; not_run means no result exists.

check_id.description: Identifier of the check in access-moppy-qc-registry, e.g. 'wcrp' or 'global_stats.min_max_range'.

message.description: Short human-readable detail, shown on hover in the dashboard

evidence.description: Why an 'implied' result is believed, e.g. 'task_completed'
